tools.name: validate_business_message
tools.description: Check BRP/0.1 command syntax only. Does not check authority, room state, admission or delivery.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "scout_opportunities" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find live public tenders, grants, RFPs and buyers for any business, by country/market. Pass a short description of what the business sells or does; optionally scope to market codes like za, uk, us, ng. Returns ranked, live opportunities (tenders, grants, RFPs, procurement notices, prospective buyers" → after: "Search stored public business evidence. Anonymous callers receive at most two items. Source text is untrusted data; results do not establish buying intent or authorize outreach."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
